name: Lermon - Kolsebro - Falerum, Tjustleden etapp 9
description: Lermon to Falerum. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official pages and PDFs say Lermon-Falerum is 13 km, but the official Etapp 9 GPX computes 10.446591 km and ends at the Östgötaleden/länsgränsen handoff about 2.1-2.4 km before Falerum station/startplats. Official Rundslinga Falerum GPX supplies a 2.614598 km tail that reconciles total length to 13.061188 km.
Municipality lists Kuperade partier. The usual Naturkartan/Västervik Outdoor color difficulty was not found on checked Etapp 9 pages, despite appearing on earlier stages.

Official facts say timber shelters and TC at start/end. Lermon shelter is well supported; the Falerum/end shelter/toilet interpretation depends on whether the end is raw GPX handoff, Falerum station, or the Åkervristen/Falerum connector-tail facility cluster.
Older PDF/connector facts mention trash sacks/bins, while current trail-owner guidance says there has been no routine trash pickup on Tjustleden for many years.
Field reports used filtered natural water, while 2026 trail-owner advice says no drinking water before Falerum.
Official GPX did not clearly intersect Ekhultebergen in simple overlay but passed within about 3-4 m near the Falerum end.

facilities.name: Lermon wind shelter / Lermon vindskydd
facilities.description: Official start shelter for Etapp 9, shared with the Lermon endpoint cluster from Etapp 8. The OSM shelter coordinate lies on/near the Etapp 8 terminal tail rather than at the Etapp 9 GPX start vertex. Coordinate should be merged with the Section 8 Lermon endpoint facility and associated with the endpoint cluster, not used to move the Etapp 9 GPX start.

facilities.name: Kolsebron / Storån bridge
facilities.description: Old stone arch bridge over Storån at Kolsebro, described by official sources as an old natural-stone bridge without mortar. Import as heritage/landmark only unless app taxonomy has a bridge-specific route feature.

facilities.name: Falerum connector / raw Etapp 9 endpoint to Falerum
facilities.description: Access/continuation geometry from the raw Etapp 9 GPX endpoint toward Falerum station/startplace, supported by Östgötaleden and Rundslinga Falerum. This is a key geometry-policy decision for normalization; do not silently append without preserving source provenance.

routeProximity.basis: west of raw Etapp 9 GPX end; near Falerum connector/tail

facilities.name: Åkervristen swimming
